1.2.description:
Changelog: 

- Fixed a logic bug where Upper Burenia Hub was reachable without Quiet Robe
- Significantly increased generation success with extreme randomizer configurations
- Changed condition of generator success to 90% total reachability before goal
- Changed where Itorash connector is placed in Transport Rando to prevent the game from being beaten too quickly
- Added the Client app too the launcher. 

I will soon be adding plans to just add the client to the .apworld to conserve space and make managing Github stuff easier. It will also make it so users dont have to download 2 seperate files.

1.6.6.description:
Major Changes:

- Added All Bosses `game_goal` (BETA)
- Added 100% `game_goal`
- Added Sound Mixer to client
- AP World version is now displayed on the title screen
- Added a bunch of new options to the in-client YAML creator

Other changes:

- uses Python Venv for unique dependancies
- shortened the Laucher Description
- fixed lua tester
- Fixed Deathlink not sharing player name
- Generator logic no longer expects nerfed power bombs to open charge beam doors
- Reduced minimum Start Kit locations from 3 to 2 (fixing Phantom Cloak at start)
- Added `open-dread-rando` to the automatically installed dependancies (idk why i didnt do that before)
- Fixed an issue where trick settings had options that didnt exist
- Fixed Require Flash Shift options
- Map Trackers now wait for critical events (Quiet Robe/X Released) before declaring checks locked behind those events to be in logic
- YAML creator trick options now match Randovania's terminology for easier paralells
- Added a new in-game icon to destinguish in-logic checks and out of logic checks in the pause map
- Fixed a bug where flash shift upgrades would not get placed due to too many filler items


Sorry for the huge delay guys, I started working on too many shenanigans when a bunch of bug reports came in. Hopefully this fixes a lot of issues for yall and let me know if you find any issues. Thank yall for supporting me with this! :D
1.6.6.title: Version 1.6.6
